t: Upgrade your viewing experience with this Ross flat-to-wall TV mount, the perfect blend of minimalist design and practical functionality. Designed to keep your TV securely mounted and out of reach from children and pets. Compatible with screens from 32” to 70” (81–178cm) and supporting up to 60kg, it fits VESA patterns ranging from 200mm x 200mm to 400mm x 400mm. With a slim profile of just 1.95cm from the wall, it helps you save space while maintaining a sleek aesthetic. Fixtures and fittings included.
b: Locking Mechanism Secures TV to Wall
Mount Your TV Just 1.95cm From the Wall
Comes Complete With all Fixtures & Fittings
